name: Ludhiana
desc: Families and professionals in Ludhiana, Punjab trust Insurance Support for transparent, independent insurance advisory. From policy selection to complex claim recoveries, our IRDAI-certified experts provide dedicated doorstep service.
it_focus: Group mediclaim and employee compensation insurance for factory workers in Focal Point and hosiery clusters.
senior_focus: NRI parent health insurance plans and doorstep LIC maturity claim help for senior families in Sarabha Nagar and BRS Nagar.
branch_dets: Direct coordination with LIC Divisional Office at Bharat Nagar Chowk and major insurer branches on Ferozepur Road.

local_faqs.question: Which hospitals in Ludhiana accept cashless health insurance?
local_faqs.answer: Dayanand Medical College Hospital, Fortis Ludhiana, SPS Apollo Hospitals, and Deep Hospital are included in our cashless network.

local_faqs.question: Do you assist NRI families with LIC policy servicing in Ludhiana?
local_faqs.answer: Yes, we manage NRI-owned LIC policies including revival, nomination changes, maturity claims, and NRE/NRO documentation support.
